headline: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse AI shopping agent from its site
summary: Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on Amazon.com on behalf of its users. Outlets differ on the reason Amazon gave: a safety risk, credentials and transparency concerns, or a violation of Amazon's Conditions of Use.

claims.statement: Amazon blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on its site.

sources.quote: Amazon bars Meta's Muse AI from shopping on its site
Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
Meta's Muse AI agent has been blocked from shopping Amazon on behalf of its users

discrepancies.explanation: Outlets differ on Amazon's stated reason: engadget cites a safety risk, theregister cites credentials and transparency concerns, and theverge cites a Conditions-of-Use violation.

quotes.quote: Amazon claims Meta's Muse is a safety risk
Retailer cites credentials and transparency concerns
continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use
